description: Altivar 320 variable speed drive: every parameter, by its Modbus (logic) address
source: Schneider Electric, Altivar 320 communication parameters (NVE41316 V3.5)
notes: The address of each parameter is its logic address, which is also its Modbus register address.
Each name ends with the parameter code used in the drive menus and manuals.
Parameters marked 'writable only when the motor is stopped' are refused while the drive runs.
Many enumerations are shared lists in the source file; only the parameter-specific ones are included here.
